body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: a22cd58fa620a0f8bcdd3597cc24ff5a57cebff3 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:
- Implements #3476 option 2 exactly: a single kind wrapper matching the operation's kind tag produces a refusal that appends `Corrected call: edit_operation ` with lossless flat arguments; mismatched kinds, extra outer keys, unknown fields, malformed values and command-check failures stay refused without a corrected call (`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`, the `map_err` arm). The suggestion preserves the requested name and every inner patch value, is never executed during the refusal, and never executes the user's original call: the only new path constructs the command to check it and otherwise returns the original error.
- The refusal keeps the original parser error text, so the corrected call is additive, never a replacement.
- Tests cover retry, undo/redo, an escaped display name (`"Pocket \"finish\" \\ pass"`), nested fields with null removal, and invalid inputs (negative/non-number stepdown, nested unknown fields, extra outer keys, a non-object wrapper). The unchanged regression test now runs as a normal test (the known-fail marker is gone).
- Process files: one skill row changed (`edit_operation`), body carries `Process change: yes`, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched. No snapshot PNGs, no `.github/`/scripts/`build.rs`/AGENTS.md/`.claude/agents/` changes, no new `camcraft-*` dependency, no new top-level test binary, conventional subject, body ends `Fixes #3476` with a `Changelog:` line.

Results merged with main (trial merge into `origin/main` 2394b5ad1efc573b7b99a898a02cc4225b4d9893, no conflicts, no hand edits; branch `pr-4488-review`, local worktree `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr4488-review`):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_enum_patch` (debug): 6 passed, 0 failed. All three tests named in the body pass: `nested_job_params_refusal_supplies_a_usable_flat_call`, `invalid_kind_wrappers_and_unknown_fields_remain_refused`, `corrected_contour_call_preserves_nested_fields_and_null_removal`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean, exit 0.
- The author's local runs are reported in the PR body (quick plan suites, `mcp_doc_drift`, light lane PASS at this head); I did not re-run those suites.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): not run in this review - the dry-run selects a release build of motion+app plus eleven release twins, too heavy for the time box on this box. Recorded honestly as not run; the body reports a PASS at this head. A red light run would be a note, not a blocker.
- No post, toolpath or geometry change: no example-catalog suites required. No `P1`/`P2` under the safety floor; no targeted heavy step.
- Not exercised: any real MCP call over stdio, UI paths, the full release/heavy lanes.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking):
- The PR is non-draft (the contributor's body calls it a draft; the flag says ready). Fork-PR state left untouched per the review rule.
- The decision file (`docs/decisions/3476-nested-params-guidance.md`) is a reasonable record and does not claim a broader contract change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
